about.headline: Engineering Polymer Excellence for a Global Market
about.story: Founded in 2008 in Western India, Trident Enterprise has grown from a regional compounder into a globally trusted name in plastic granule manufacturing. Our 80,000 sq.ft. integrated facility produces over 50,000 tons of premium polymer compounds annually, serving leading OEMs and converters across packaging, automotive, construction and electrical sectors.
about.mission: To set the global benchmark for polymer purity, consistency and supply reliability — empowering our clients to manufacture with absolute confidence.
about.vision: To be the most trusted plastic raw material partner across emerging markets by 2030, recognized for engineering excellence and ethical sourcing.
